draft.subject: Following up on your bulk import question
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for the note that things are going well so far. Your question about importing from a spreadsheet is open with Tariq, and he'll follow up with an update there.

One thing I can share now: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the next step with you and your teammate so the work you've set up starts paying off.

Best,
Chidi
